# KoomBei

> KoomBei (KoomBei Digital Limited) is a web design and development studio based in Accra, Ghana, building professional, affordable websites for NGOs, nonprofits, and young startups worldwide. Tagline: "Dream with us. Rise with us." Built with care, priced with honesty.

Key facts:
- Three packages, priced in Ghana Cedis (GHS): Seed (GHS 2,500, up to 5 pages, 7 to 14 days), Rise (GHS 3,500, up to 8 pages, 14 to 21 days), Summit (GHS 6,000, up to 15 pages, 21 to 30 days). All include design, development, hosting setup, and SSL.
- Verified NGOs, nonprofits, and startups registered under 2 years get 20% off any package.
- Fully remote process: discovery form, video calls, live previews. Clients worldwide; support across time zones; proposals within 48 hours.
- Payment: Mobile Money and bank transfer in Ghana; bank transfer for international clients. Every site is hand-coded (no page builders) and deployed on Vercel.
- Founder: Frank Koomson. Contact: info@koombei.com

- [Home](https://koombei.com): what KoomBei does, packages, process, portfolio highlights, FAQ
- [Services and pricing](https://koombei.com/pages/services): full package details, standalone services, timelines
- [Portfolio](https://koombei.com/pages/portfolio): 11 live client websites with descriptions and links
- [About](https://koombei.com/pages/about): the story and meaning behind the KoomBei name
- [Start a project](https://koombei.com/pages/contact): discovery form, free consultation, payment details
- [The KoomBei Circle](https://koombei.com/pages/circle): free membership for clients

## Case studies

- [SWK Ghana](https://koombei.com/pages/work/swk-ghana): full organisational site for a youth nonprofit
- [RuboLink](https://koombei.com/pages/work/rubolink): a service marketplace with Mobile Money and card payments
- [Timoya Farms](https://koombei.com/pages/work/timoya-farms): a fast, framework-free site for an agriculture business
- [Lafie Plus](https://koombei.com/pages/work/lafie-plus): an accessible frontend platform
